jobs.title: Manager Sales Strategy & Planning
jobs.description:
Job Details:
Summary:

The SS&P Manager is a key member of the Foodservice Prepared team, supporting the K–12 and Distribution channels. This role handles day-to-day execution and support, and helps deliver against annual financial and volume targets for Tyson Foodservice Prepared categories. The Manager works alongside the Senior Managers who set growth strategy 12+ months out, and turns that strategy into reliable results for customers and the field.

This position is a critical link between field sales, supply chain, demand planning, and business unit teams. The Manager is the go-to resource for customer and field questions that need more than the tools and information on hand, and turns insights into actions that improve execution in market. The role emphasizes performance analytics, distribution effectiveness, and channel-specific dynamics, including distributor network performance.

The SS&P Manager works in a highly cross-functional environment and plays a central role in aligning strategy with execution, so the sales organization can win with customers and operators. The ideal candidate shows strong ownership, analytical capability, and a proactive mindset, and can quickly synthesize information into clear recommendations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
- Performance & Insights: Analyze category and product performance. Deliver actionable insights that identify growth opportunities and risks.
- Strategy & Planning: Support development and execution of K–12 and Distribution channel strategies aligned to business objectives.
- Sales Support: Partner with field sales to translate strategy into clear priorities, tools, and actions that drive in-market execution.
- Customer Resolution: Serve as the go-to resource for customer and field questions and issues that go beyond available tools and resources, driving each to resolution.
- Distribution & Execution: Monitor distributor performance, product distribution, and operator penetration. Identify and close execution gaps.
- Demand & Readiness: Manage day-to-day demand, forecast, inventory, and CID/load-in readiness, using Customer Insights data.
- Forecasting & S&OP: Provide input to demand forecasts and actively participate in S&OP to align on trends, risks, and opportunities.
- Promotions: Develop short-term promotional growth opportunities, including Truck Load, and support promo execution.
- Product Impact Management: Monitor product impacts (fill rate, capacity, SKU) and troubleshoot the resulting customer service issues. Recommend support solutions for customers, align get-well dates with the business unit, and communicate them to the field.
- Business Enablement & Communications: Develop and maintain customer- and channel-facing materials (brand material, sell sheets, attribute file) and field communications that support sales execution across K–12 and Distribution.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the key liaison across sales, supply chain, demand planning, and business teams to ensure alignment and results.
- Request Management: Manage incoming field and customer requests.
- Model behaviors that support Tyson Foods' behaviors and leadership principles.

Requirements:

Education:
- Bachelor's Degree required

Experience:
- Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in customer trade marketing, sales, marketing, sales analytics, revenue management or category management.
- Demonstrated financial acumen, with joint growth planning experience a plus
- Demonstrated ability to partner with and influence cross-functional team members

Communication Skills:
- Excellent organizational and communication skills;
- Strong influencing and negotiating skills.
- Strong ability to articulate complex information in a concise manner and with proper context

Computer Skills:
- Intermediate-Advanced level for MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint & Teams;
- Prior experience with Tyson CRM preferred

Special Skills:
- Excellent planning and project management skills
- Syndicated Data experience
- Strong Excel and data manipulation skills
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
- Business acumen and ownership

Direct Reports: 0
Travel: Some travel is required, up to 10% of time

jobs.title: Manager Continuous Improvement- 1st Shift- Green Forest Plant
jobs.location: Green Forest Plant - Green Forest, Arkansas
jobs.description:
Job Details:
Continuous Improvement Leader
Summary
The Continuous Improvement (CI) Leader is responsible for driving and sustaining a culture of continuous improvement throughout the facility. This role serves as the subject matter expert for Continuous Improvement initiatives, providing training, coaching, and leadership to Production Team Members, Engineers, and Functional Leaders. The CI Leader partners with all levels of the organization to implement Lean principles, lead change management efforts, and improve operational performance.
This position focuses on enhancing safety, food safety, quality, delivery performance, inventory management, cost reduction, and overall process efficiency. The CI Leader facilitates improvement projects, develops operational excellence strategies, and ensures measurable results that support business objectives.
Key Responsibilities
- Lead and facilitate Kaizen events and Rapid Improvement Processes (RIPs).
- Identify, analyze, and track improvement opportunities through data collection and performance metrics.
- Promote compliance with safety, environmental, food safety, and quality standards.
- Demonstrate expertise in Lean Manufacturing principles and Continuous Improvement methodologies.
- Develop and implement strategies that improve productivity, efficiency, and process effectiveness.
- Train and coach employees at all levels on problem-solving tools and methodologies, including: - Process Mapping
- Standardized Work
- Lean Manufacturing
- Six Sigma
- Time and Cost Management

- Lead Continuous Improvement projects focused on process optimization, cost reduction, and performance improvement.
- Maintain project schedules, progress reports, and documentation demonstrating measurable operational improvements.
- Partner with plant leadership to analyze staffing, labor utilization, capacity, and operational performance.
- Calculate and validate cost savings and improvement opportunities.
- Collaborate with the Plant Controller to document financial results and project savings.
- Monitor and report the status of all CI initiatives to plant leadership.
- Validate and confirm production standards and process expectations.
- Assist in monitoring equipment effectiveness (OEE) and partner with Maintenance to identify TPM, repair, and reliability opportunities.
- Develop and maintain value stream maps for key processes and product families.
- Support additional Continuous Improvement initiatives as assigned by the Senior Manager of Continuous Improvement.

Qualifications
Education
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.
- Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

Experience
- Five or more years of demonstrated Continuous Improvement experience; or
- Five or more years of leadership experience in a Lean manufacturing environment.
- Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification, or progress toward certification, preferred.

Communication Skills
- Ability to effectively communicate and influence individuals at all levels of the organization.
- Strong coaching, mentoring, and facilitation skills.

Travel
- Minimal travel required (four or fewer trips per year).

Technical and Leadership Skills
- Strong business acumen and analytical skills.
- Extensive knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, and other Continuous Improvement methodologies.
- Strong process management and project leadership experience.
- Ability to lead change, drive accountability, and deliver measurable operational results.
- Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

Yes
